build_FBcprModel: build a python module to instantiate FBcprModel with kwargs for obs_dim, action_dim, and device
create_CriticArchiConfig: create a CriticArchiConfig dataclass with hidden_dim, model type, hidden_layers, and ensemble_mode settings
create_DiscriminatorArchiConfig: create a DiscriminatorArchiConfig dataclass with hidden_dim and hidden_layers for discriminator architecture
run_FBcprModel_critic: run the FBcprModel critic method with observation, latent z, and action tensors to get Q-value
run_FBcprModel_discriminator: run the FBcprModel discriminator method with observation and latent z tensors to get discriminator output
